exceptions.rationale: Supplemental upstream version query, NOT exact +cpu build certification. torch 2.8.0+cpu is part of the frozen, qualified AI runtime identity, which ADR-028 section 1 forbids rewriting; upgrading in place would silently relabel historical results. Frozen actor uses feed-forward tensor operations; no torch.jit.script, lstm_cell, unpack_sequence, linalg.lu, rot90 or pt2 loading path found in current AI source. Integer conversion input remains bounded by validated observations. weights_only unpickling is used and remains vulnerable to crafted checkpoints: only operator-owned hash-verified immutable checkpoints may reach the loader. Hash identity is not a sandbox if the trusted producer is compromised. No arbitrary uploaded checkpoint inference is authorized. These constraints limit exposure; they do not patch the library.
exceptions.remediation: Successor plan (ADR-028 section 1): a versioned successor CPU runtime with torch >=2.13.0 (current highest advertised fix) delivered as a new runtime identity, never a relabel. Reevaluate unpatched PYSEC-2026-139 applicability, audit the exact wheel/SBOM, run deterministic tensor/load/tamper and isolated inference regressions, then source/image/model-bound requalification. Repeated training and qualification evidence are owner actions (ADR-028 section 5) and are not invented. Do not alter the historical environment or weights.

exceptions.rationale: emulation/requirements.frozen.txt (with emulation/Dockerfile.frozen) pins the frozen historical lab runtime that recorded campaign results depend on (ADR-028 section 1: not rewritten). Upstream has no fixed release for these OpenFlow parser infinite loops. OpenFlow from lab OVS reaches the parser: malicious/compromised switches remain a real DoS risk. ADR-028 C23 makes the successor lab the default and restricts the frozen privileged image to the explicit opt-in historical-reproduction overlay (deploy/compose.lab.frozen.yaml / NANFO_LAB_FROZEN=1). Exception applies only to isolated operator-owned emulation, never an untrusted switch or public controller service.
exceptions.remediation: Successor (ADR-028 section 1, C23): emulation/Dockerfile on a supported base with the hash-pinned lock emulation/requirements.txt replaces Ryu with the maintained os-ken 4.2.2 controller (audited in the emulation lane); remaining: malformed-frame tests, then source/image-bound requalification before any result claim. Preserve historical bytes. Shortest expiry: the controller parser is the most exposed component.

exceptions.rationale: Frozen Ryu requires ALREADY_HANDLED removed in later eventlet. WebSocket exhaustion, DNS interference and WSGI request smuggling remain unpatched here. No public WSGI/WebSocket listener is authorized; lab DNS and controller peers must remain isolated. PYSEC-2026-1307 and 2472 alias the same CVE but both exact feed IDs are reviewed. Reachable only through the frozen opt-in overlay (ADR-028 C23).
exceptions.remediation: Successor lock emulation/requirements.txt (ADR-028 C23) pins eventlet 0.41.2 with os-ken instead of Ryu; remaining: exercise HTTP/WebSocket/DNS boundaries and requalify before promotion.

exceptions.rationale: Frozen eventlet DNS dependency is susceptible to TuDoor. Numeric lab addresses reduce routine DNS exposure; hostile network DNS remains a risk, not a proven unreachable path. Reachable only through the frozen opt-in overlay (ADR-028 C23).
exceptions.remediation: Successor lock emulation/requirements.txt (ADR-028 C23) pins dnspython 2.8.0; remaining: DNS regression and qualification.

exceptions.rationale: Frozen controller HTTP dependency; hostile Location targets can redirect off-host. No public redirect/SSO use is authorized in this operator-only lab. Do not expose Ryu web services to untrusted callers. Reachable only through the frozen opt-in overlay (ADR-028 C23).
exceptions.remediation: Successor lock emulation/requirements.txt (ADR-028 C23) pins WebOb 1.8.11; remaining: redirect/control-character tests and image requalification.

exceptions.rationale: Streaming Unpacker reuse after errors can crash. NANFO emulation exchanges JSON, not an exposed MessagePack input endpoint; transitively installed Ryu code still requires review before new RPC use. Reachable only through the frozen opt-in overlay (ADR-028 C23).
exceptions.remediation: Successor lock emulation/requirements.txt (ADR-028 C23) pins msgpack 1.2.2; remaining: a malformed-stream regression.

exceptions.rationale: Frozen client dependency retains TLS-session verification persistence, netrc disclosure and zipped-path temporary-file flaws. Lab destinations must be operator-controlled; no host netrc credentials or shared writable temp mounts. These constraints limit exposure and do not patch the library.
exceptions.remediation: Successor lock emulation/requirements.txt (ADR-028 C23) pins requests 2.34.2; remaining: TLS, redirect, credential and temporary-file regressions.

exceptions.rationale: Oversized attacker-controlled Unicode hostnames can consume CPU. Operator-defined numeric lab endpoints reduce exposure; arbitrary remote URL inputs are outside the exception scope.
exceptions.remediation: Successor lock emulation/requirements.txt (ADR-028 C23) pins idna 3.20; remaining: hostname-boundary tests.

exceptions.rationale: Frozen HTTP dependency retains redirect/header leakage and response decompression DoS. Only controlled lab endpoints are authorized; malicious responses remain exploitable if that boundary fails. Do not use this runtime for arbitrary web fetching.
exceptions.remediation: Successor lock emulation/requirements.txt (ADR-028 C23) pins urllib3 2.8.0; remaining: bounded decompression and cross-origin redirect credential tests plus requalification.

coverage_gaps.reason: Dependency not found on PyPI and could not be audited: torch (2.8.0+cpu)
coverage_gaps.rationale: Exact CPU wheel comes from download.pytorch.org, absent from PyPI audit inventory. This is an explicit coverage failure, not a clean Torch result. No version normalization or blanket package ignore is permitted. The wheel is part of the frozen qualified AI runtime identity (ADR-028 section 1).
coverage_gaps.remediation: The separate ai-upstream lane gates public torch 2.8.0 advisories but does not close this exact-build gap. Review the exact CPU build/SBOM; the successor AI runtime (ADR-028 section 1) requires a new identity and requalification. Never load untrusted checkpoint/pickle inputs.
